readme_excerpt: Read this in other languages. First Contributions This project aims to simplify and guide the way beginners make their first contribution. If you are looking to make your first contribution, follow the steps below. If you're not comfortable with command line, here are tutorials using GUI tools. If you don't have git on your machine, install it. Fork this repository Fork this repository by clicking on the fork button on the top of this page.
